LanguageData.RHAH_RefugeeMassacre.questDescriptionRul: questDescription->[sponsorName] says a nearby temporary ratkin camp may threaten their settlement. They want every refugee there killed within [campDays] days to prevent what they call a 'ratkin surge'. Completing the task changes goodwill by [campGoodwill].\n\nThe camp is expected to hold [campMinAdults] to [campMaxAdults] adult ratkin and [campMinChildren] to [campMaxChildren] young ratkin. There are no turrets or electricity, but the adults may be armed and predators may appear nearby. Downing or capturing residents does not count as completion.
